en.description: TOR450 - Tor des Glaciers is a ultramarathon. Location: Courmayeur, Italy. Date: 11 September 2026 – 19 September 2026. Distances: 450 km. Entry fee: check with the organiser. The map below shows the host town; check the organiser for the exact start line.
